name: companion-panel
author: Ragnarok Offline
description: Companion command panel: summon and bench saved companions, set duties (attacker/tank/support), issue stance orders, manage healer priority and save party squads for one-click recall.

settings.label: Show the Companions button
settings.description: Adds a Companions button to the party window that opens this panel. Turn it off to keep the hotkey only.

settings.label: Open with Ctrl+Shift+C
settings.description: Toggles the panel while in game. Ignored while typing in chat or a dialog.
